'''''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago''' was the thirteenth [[Celebration]] convention. The convention was held from [[April 11]] through [[April 15|15]], 2019, at McCormick Place in Chicago, Illinois.<ref name="Chicago 2019" /> It was hosted by [[David W. Collins]], [[Warwick Davis]] and [[Amy Ratcliffe]].<ref name="Collins Ratcliffe" /><ref name="Davis" /> This was the longest Star Wars Celebration to date since [[Celebration IV]], with a five-day span.

==Mural==
{{Quote|The original idea came from Kathy Kennedy. She asked if we could create a piece of art that would encapsulate the entire ''Star Wars'' saga, visually representing the complete stories of ''Star Wars'' through art. In thinking about how to fulfill Kathy's wish, the idea of creating a giant mural timeline was born.|Doug Chiang, to StarWars.com|<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=news/lucasfilm-readies-massive-mural-for-star-wars-celebration-chicago-exclusive|text=Lucasfilm Readies Massive Mural for ''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago – Exclusive}}</ref>}}
[[File:SW_franchise_mural_OT.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The original trilogy section of the mural]]
A mural depicting the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise as of [[2019]] was commissioned by [[Lucasfilm]] President [[Kathleen Kennedy]]. [[Doug Chiang]] served as the art director for the project, while [[Jason Palmer]] was the artist. The mural debuted in Celebration Chicago, and contained depictions of the [[prequel trilogy]], the [[original trilogy]], the [[sequel trilogy]], ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="SW" /> The section depicting [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] was covered on the first day of Celebration Chicago.<ref name="Force web">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/story/front/The_Star_Wars_Saga_Mural_At_Star_Wars_Celebration_183642.asp|text=The ''Star Wars'' saga mural at ''Star Wars'' Celebration|author=Dustin|date=2019-04-10|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20190730002645}}</ref>
